wiki.title: Ikaika Olds
wiki.extract: Ikaika Mark Olds is an American politician serving as a member of the Hawaii House of Representatives for the 23rd district since 2024. Olds serves as the Vice Chair of the House Human Services and Homelessness Committee and is a member of the Health, Education and Higher Education Committees. He also serves as the Vice Chair of the Keiki Caucus and is a member of the Kupuna and Native Hawaiian Caucuses.
